_comment: Import this PTDL_v2 egg into a Pterodactyl nest. The dashboard is bundled in the GHCR image.
name: Arrakis Control Dashboard
author: realxkenny@users.noreply.github.com
description: Production Arrakis Control Dashboard image. Set the required Dune Console, Discord OAuth, public URL, and Redis variables before starting.

installation.script:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
mkdir -p /mnt/server
echo 'Arrakis Control Dashboard is bundled in the Docker image. No files to install.'

variables.name: API Worker Concurrency
variables.description: Maximum active API requests per worker before overload returns 503. Tune with staging load tests.

variables.name: Global Read Budget
variables.description: Requests per read route per minute shared through Redis across workers. Increase only after capacity validation.

variables.name: Dashboard Bot API Token
variables.description: Optional independent secret for the read-only Discord bot API. Empty disables access. Never reuse Discord, Console, or adapter tokens.

variables.name: Server Bind Address
variables.description: Bind to all container interfaces so Wings can reach the dashboard.

variables.name: Dune Console URL
variables.description: URL of the Dune Console reachable from this container.

variables.name: Dune Console API Key
variables.description: Scoped Dune Console API key. Treat as a secret.

variables.name: Adapter Token
variables.description: Adapter integration token. Treat as a secret.

variables.name: Discord Client Secret
variables.description: Discord OAuth application client secret. Treat as a secret.

variables.name: Discord Guild ID
variables.description: Discord server whose members may access the dashboard.

variables.name: Public App URL
variables.description: Public HTTPS dashboard origin, for example https://portal.example.com/. The OAuth callback is /auth/callback.

variables.name: Verified Member Role ID
variables.description: Discord role required for dashboard access.

variables.name: Redis URL
variables.description: Redis TCP URL reachable from this container, with credentials; use rediss:// for TLS.
